description: Curated vocabulary of simulation-parameter keys and model-tier completeness contracts. A parameter claim (parameter-set record) uses these canonical snake_case keys; unknown keys are tolerated on import but only canonical keys count toward tier completeness. Each entry states the physical scope(s) the parameter belongs to (material = intrinsic to an active material; electrode/separator = the manufactured build; electrolyte = the formulated liquid; cell = whole-cell values and fits; state = the initial and environmental conditions a simulation starts from), the canonical unit, and where applicable the BPX field it maps from, per BPX block (BPX reuses names like 'Conductivity [S.m-1]' across blocks with different meanings). A bpx entry is either the field name, read in the key's canonical unit, or an object holding the field, the BPX unit when it differs from the canonical one ('unit') and, for the State block, the section that holds the field ('section'). The tiers block is the machine-readable completeness contract consumed by battinfo.parameters.completeness() and vendored downstream (registry, web) so every surface applies identical rules.

specific_capacity.label: Practical specific capacity
specific_capacity.description: Practical (not theoretical) reversible specific capacity of the active material.

theoretical_specific_capacity.label: Theoretical specific capacity
theoretical_specific_capacity.description: Theoretical specific capacity from stoichiometry (e.g. LiC6 372 mAh/g). Deliberately a separate key from specific_capacity: theoretical values never satisfy a model tier's practical-capacity requirement, and conflating them would corrupt design estimates.

density.label: True density
density.description: Crystallographic/true density of the active material (not electrode/tap density). At cell scope, the lumped density of the whole cell, which BPX states in kg/m3.

first_cycle_efficiency.label: First-cycle coulombic efficiency
first_cycle_efficiency.description: First-cycle coulombic efficiency in a half cell; drives lithium-inventory slippage in full-cell balancing.

ocp.label: Open-circuit potential
ocp.description: Half-cell open-circuit potential vs Li/Li+ as a function of stoichiometry. Use curve.branch for lithiation/delithiation where hysteresis matters.

thickness.label: Layer thickness
thickness.description: Coating thickness per side (electrode scope) or separator thickness.

transport_efficiency.label: Transport efficiency
transport_efficiency.description: Porous-medium transport efficiency epsilon/tau (Bruggeman epsilon^1.5 when unmeasured).

electronic_conductivity.label: Electronic conductivity
electronic_conductivity.description: Effective electronic conductivity of the porous electrode (BPX electrode-block 'Conductivity').

initial_concentration.label: Initial salt concentration
initial_concentration.description: Initial (rest) salt concentration of the electrolyte. In a BPX file it is a state value: State.Initial conditions from BPX 1.0, the Electrolyte block's 'Initial concentration [mol.m-3]' before that.

ionic_conductivity.label: Ionic conductivity
ionic_conductivity.description: Electrolyte ionic conductivity, typically a function of salt concentration (BPX electrolyte-block 'Conductivity').

nominal_capacity.label: Nominal cell capacity
nominal_capacity.description: Nominal capacity of the cell; BPX uses it to convert between current and C-rate.

electrode_area.label: Electrode area
electrode_area.description: Area of ONE electrode pair, as BPX and PyBaMM use it. The cell's total electrode area is this times electrode_pair_count.

electrode_pair_count.label: Number of electrode pairs
electrode_pair_count.description: Number of electrode pairs connected in parallel to make the cell.

bpx.cell: Number of electrode pairs connected in parallel to make a cell

specific_heat_capacity.label: Specific heat capacity
specific_heat_capacity.description: Lumped specific heat capacity of the cell.

reference_temperature.label: Reference temperature
reference_temperature.description: Reference temperature of the Arrhenius temperature dependences.

thermal_conductivity.label: Thermal conductivity
thermal_conductivity.description: Lumped thermal conductivity of the cell. A Cell field in BPX 0.x only: from BPX 1.0 the parser asks for it in User-defined, which is where to_bpx writes it for a v1 export.

series_resistance.label: Series resistance
series_resistance.description: Lumped ohmic series resistance of the cell (ECM R0 / DCIR-style fits).

initial_temperature.label: Initial temperature
initial_temperature.description: Cell temperature at the start of a simulation (a Cell field in BPX 0.x).

ambient_temperature.label: Ambient temperature
ambient_temperature.description: Temperature of the cell's surroundings (a Cell field in BPX 0.x).

initial_soc.label: Initial state of charge
initial_soc.description: State of charge at the start of a simulation, between 0 and 1.

heat_transfer_coefficient.label: Heat transfer coefficient
heat_transfer_coefficient.description: Coefficient of heat transfer between the cell surface and its surroundings.

bote.description: Back-of-the-envelope design estimation: capacity, energy, OCV construction and electrode balancing.

spm.description: Single Particle Model: adds solid-phase diffusion and interfacial kinetics per electrode material.

spme.description: SPM with electrolyte: adds electrolyte transport plus the manufactured electrode/separator build.
